# Journal source signal

Use this to suggest a public source, workflow pattern, or text-prep problem for the Text Preparation Journal.

GitHub Issues are public. Do not include private or sensitive text. Public links, summaries, and anonymized examples are best.

## Source link

Add the public URL, if available.

## What happened?

Briefly describe the text/workflow problem.

## Why does this seem like a text-preparation problem?

Example: formatting broke, AI output needed review, PDF paste became messy, generated copy had filler, TTS/SSML needed cleanup, publishing workflow stalled.
